meta.name: instagram-hashtag-posts
meta.description: Scrapes Instagram posts by hashtag, returning media items with captions, like/comment counts, media URLs and user info from the hashtag explore feed. Use when user mentions Instagram hashtag scraping, get posts by hashtag, IG hashtag feed, scrape Instagram by tag, hashtag posts Instagram, search Instagram hashtag, pull posts from hashtag, Instagram topic posts, trending hashtag content, Instagram tag posts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按话题标签抓取 Instagram 帖子数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取 Instagram 话题标签下的帖子内容
copy.tagline_en: Scrape Instagram posts by hashtag for media and engagement data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to collect Instagram posts by hashtag for analysis

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动抓取指定 Instagram 话题标签下的热门帖子，返回每条帖子的图片/视频链接、文字描述、点赞数、评论数和发布者用户名。
howto.when: 当你提到需要获取 Instagram 话题标签的帖子，例如说“帮我搜一下 #travel 的帖子”或“拉取 #food 的 Instagram 内容”时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下 #travel 的 Instagram 热门帖子。
say.note: Claude 会抓取该标签下的帖子列表。

say.text: 拉取 #food 标签的帖子，要前20条。
say.note: Claude 会返回最多20条帖子信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically scrape top posts for a given Instagram hashtag, returning each post's media URL, caption, like/comment counts, and username.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention scraping Instagram hashtag posts, e.g., "get posts for #travel" or "pull #food Instagram content".

say_en.note: Claude will fetch the post list for that hashtag.
Claude will return up to 20 posts.
